1.w: For the one directing. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. All [you] peoples, clap your hands; shout unto God, with a voice of a ringing cry!

2.w: For YHWH-Elyon [is] to be feared; [He is] the great King over all the earth.

3.w: He turns back the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

4.w: He chose for us our inheritance, the excellence of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah

5.w: God has gone up with a shout, YHWH with the voice of a shofar.

6.w: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!

7.w: For the King of all the earth [is] God—sing praises [with] skill!

8.w: God reigns over the nations; God sits upon the throne of His holiness.

9.w: The princes of the peoples have gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth [are] unto God—[He is] greatly to be exalted.
